Resolves #20566

🌿 A tree grid can no longer tell a screen reader that an open branch is shut.

`Neo.grid.Row` stamps `aria-expanded` from `collapsed`, the field `TreeModel` declares and `TreeStore` keeps. It used to read `expanded`, which no model declares, so every parent row of every tree grid had announced itself collapsed since #9408.

Evidence: L1 (unit, Node) → L1 required (AC-1 and AC-2 are row vdom contracts). Residual: none.

Micro-review eligible: restoration — one line in `src/grid/Row.mjs` and a three-case spec.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/unit/grid/TreeRowAria.spec.mjs` (expanded parent → `true`, collapsed → `false`, leaf → no attribute) |
| AC-2 | Outside-CI red run: against `dev`'s `Row.mjs` the spec fails the expanded case (1 failed, 2 passed); 3/3 at the head. `unit/grid` + `unit/data`: 838 passed at the head |

## Deltas from ticket
None substantive.

## Test Evidence
The red-first run above is the only evidence outside CI.

**Class:** contained — bounded one-line restoration in `src/grid/Row.mjs` (`vdom['aria-expanded'] = record.collapsed === false`) aligning `Neo.grid.Row#createVdom` with `Neo.data.TreeModel`'s `collapsed` field (`defaultValue: true`) and `TreeStore#collectVisibleDescendants`'s `node.collapsed === false` predicate, paired with a 3-case unit spec (`test/playwright/unit/grid/TreeRowAria.spec.mjs`).

**Verdict:** Approved

**Glance:** Verified against exact head `7ec3eee03977e1ed4b89ca3491aae5fbe7c995aa` (all required CI checks green), `src/grid/Row.mjs:444-454`, `src/data/TreeModel.mjs:33-36`, and `src/data/TreeStore.mjs:356`. `TreeModel` defines `collapsed` (`defaultValue: true`) and never defines `expanded`, so `record.expanded || false` evaluated to `false` on every non-leaf row since `#9408`.
